text:
Ryan (AE): tagging execs — Asteria Capital just surfaced three blockers that need an exec touchpoint tomorrow morning. CISO is asking for SLA + HSM details, procurement wants committed pricing, and their infra team says TLS peering is failing in our EU region. Can we sync?
Mia (CS): copy, what's the exact ask on HSM? are they requiring BYOK or just KMS integration?
Ryan (AE): they want HSM-backed key lifecycle and an auditor statement that keys never leave their tenancy; basically BYOK + HSM + DPA annex. They said to treat it as a blocker for pilot sign-off.
Sanjay (Eng Lead): BYOK + HSM is doable in Private (on-prem / VPC) path but not in hosted today. We can provide attestation notes and KMS integrations for Dedicated — need time to scope hardware certs. ETA 3 days to produce a runbook and 2 weeks for validation with Asteria infra.
Jen (Solutions): on pricing — they asked for committed 3-month burst plan estimate for 4x expected peak with a canary region. I can draft number but need expected qps and token mix. Ryan, can you drop the POC traffic profile?
Ryan (AE): sending profile now. baseline: 120 qps peak, 32 tokens/resp avg, heavy embedding batch jobs at night (2000 embeddings/min). They want 99th pct latency <250ms at peak.
infra-bot: deploy-check: eu-west-1 routing healthy on Canary-1 cluster, but certificate mismatch detected for 10.42.8.0/24 -> tls-handshake-failure.
Sanjay (Eng Lead): that cert mismatch lines up with the customer's peering fingerprint. Likely SNI mismatch from their edge. Can we get their peering config?
Mia (CS): Asteria infra sent this snip: ```peer_cidr: 10.42.8.0/24
peer_asn: 64512
tls_sni: api.ast-priv.asteria.local
allowed_ips: 10.42.8.0/24``` They also attached a PCAP showing TLS alert 40.
Elaine (CISO): quick security note — before any exec call I need to confirm SOC2 scope, encryption at rest details, key rotation policy, and whether audit logs can be forwarded to their SIEM (we support syslog/S3 export?). Also need to know our breach notification SLA.
Priya (Legal): DPA addendum: they'll require DPA + data residency clause + subprocessor list. We can provide current subproc list but sign-off requires legal review. I can fast-track but need CFO ok for commercial terms.
Jen (Solutions): Operationally, here's a recommended path to unblock in 48–72h: 1) propose a dedicated canary in eu-west with VPC peering + customer BYOK option on Dedicated, 2) provide temporary cert workaround (mutual TLS) while they fix SNI, 3) provide committed pricing overlay for 3 months with burst credits. I can draft the canary runbook today.
Ryan (AE): can we get a short one-pager to share with Asteria execs for tomorrow AM run-through? They want clear asks and timeline.
Sanjay (Eng Lead): I'll produce a technical appendix for the one-pager outlining: HSM feasibility (private only), estimated perf with their profile, and mitigation for TLS peering (mutual TLS config snippet). ETA 10:00 PT tomorrow.
Elaine (CISO): I'll provide a security checklist and confirm which logs we can stream. ETA 09:30 PT.
Priya (Legal): I'll prepare a DPA redline and a short note on timelines for subprocessor disclosure. ETA EOD today for prelim.
Mia (CS): I'll own the exec invite and coordinate a 30m slot at 08:30 PT — Ryan pls confirm Asteria availability.
Ryan (AE): confirmed 08:30 PT works for Asteria execs. Please include: CTO, CISO, and Head of Procurement.
Jen (Solutions): I'm drafting the pricing sketch now — dropping numbers by 18:30 UTC.
Sanjay (Eng Lead): quick config to try for mutual TLS workaround (to paste in the one-pager):
```
# customer edge
client_cert: /etc/ssl/asteria-client.crt
client_key: /etc/ssl/asteria-client.key
sni: api.redwood-dedicated.internal
peer_cidr: 10.42.8.0/24
```
Mia (CS): thanks — team agreed owners, timeline, and exec slot. I'll annotate action items.
Ryan (AE): perfect. Last ask from exec: they want cost delta between hosted vs. dedicated with BYOK/HSM. Jen + Finance estimate please.
Jen (Solutions): looping finance — can you get a committed 3-month delta estimate with burst pricing?
infra-bot: finance-request: ticket #FIN-8421 created for committed pricing estimate (owner: Finance Ops).
Priya (Legal): noted — I'll push DPA draft to the thread and tag Ryan when ready.
Sanjay (Eng Lead): will post the tech appendix link in this thread when ready.
Mia (CS): summary for tomorrow's exec touchpoint (will paste into calendar invite): "Proposed canary in eu-west with Dedicated + BYOK, mutual TLS mitigation, DPA timeline, committed pricing delta. Owners: Eng (Sanjay), Solutions (Jen), Legal (Priya), CS (Mia), AE (Ryan). Deliverables by 10:00 PT tomorrow."
Ryan (AE): thanks all. If we can get those artifacts uploaded by 09:30 PT it's ideal. I'll follow up with Asteria to confirm attendees.
Jen (Solutions): uploading initial pricing sketch to thread now.
Sanjay (Eng Lead): uploaded tech appendix v0.1 -> link: https://files.redwood.internal/asteria/tech-appendix-v0.1.pdf
Mia (CS): got it. See you on the call tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Ryan (AE): closing the loop — exec invite sent, channel updated. Will post post-call notes here.
